value.name: Migraine
value.description: Migraine is a neurological condition characterized by recurrent headaches that can be severe and debilitating. It often involves throbbing pain, typically on one side of the head, and can be accompanied by other symptoms like nausea and sensitivity to light and sound. Migraines can significantly impact daily life and work.
symptoms: Severe throbbing or pulsing headache, often on one side
causes: Changes in brainstem activity and its interaction with the trigeminal nerve system
Environmental triggers (e.g., stress, certain foods, hormonal changes)

value.name: Tension-Type Headache
value.description: Tension-type headaches are the most common type of headache, often described as a constant ache or pressure around the head, especially at the temples or back of the head and neck. They are usually mild to moderate in intensity and not typically associated with nausea or vomiting. These headaches are often linked to stress and muscle tension.
symptoms: Sensation of tightness or pressure across the forehead
Tenderness in scalp, neck, and shoulder muscles
Mild sensitivity to light or sound
Feeling of a band tightening around the head
causes: Muscle strain in the neck and shoulders

value.name: Sinusitis
value.description: Sinusitis, also known as a sinus infection, is an inflammation of the sinuses, which are air-filled cavities in the skull. It can be caused by infections (viral, bacterial, or fungal) or allergies, leading to blockage and mucus buildup. Symptoms often include facial pain and pressure, nasal congestion, and a reduced sense of smell.
symptoms: Facial pain and pressure (forehead, cheeks, around eyes)
Reduced sense of smell and taste

value.name: Concussion
value.description: A concussion is a traumatic brain injury (TBI) caused by a bump, blow, or jolt to the head, or by a hit to the body that causes the head and brain to move rapidly back and forth. This sudden movement can cause the brain to bounce around or twist in the skull, leading to chemical changes in the brain and sometimes stretching and damaging brain cells. Symptoms can range from brief loss of consciousness to confusion and memory problems.
symptoms: Headache or pressure in the head

value.name: Meningitis
value.description: Meningitis is an inflammation of the meninges, the membranes that surround the brain and spinal cord. It is most often caused by a viral or bacterial infection. Bacterial meningitis is particularly serious and can be life-threatening if not treated promptly with antibiotics. Symptoms include severe headache, fever, and a stiff neck.
causes: Certain medical conditions (e.g., cancer, autoimmune diseases)
